challenges.title: Study Sprint
challenges.scenario: Your exam is tomorrow. Turn tonight's lecture notes into five revision points.
challenges.objective: Drag five key concepts into the summary tray.
challenges.educationalMessage: AI can turn long notes into short summaries. On supported Intel AI PCs, compatible apps can run that work on the device.

packets.label: Notes summary
packets.caption: The summary app supports on-device processing.

challenges.title: Creator Mode
challenges.scenario: Your photo for tonight's post needs a glow-up.
challenges.objective: Apply the three tools in the right order.
challenges.educationalMessage: AI creative tools can edit and enhance photos faster. On supported Intel AI PCs, some of these effects can run on the device, while others run on the GPU.

packets.label: Background removal
packets.caption: This effect can run on the device in a compatible app.

packets.label: Style filter
packets.caption: This effect stays on the GPU in this demo.

challenges.title: Privacy Shield
challenges.scenario: A confidential contract needs an AI summary. Where should it be processed?
challenges.objective: Choose where the document is processed.
challenges.educationalMessage: Compatible AI apps can run on your device, so your document doesn't leave it. Privacy depends on the app and its settings, not only on the chip.
challenges.resultLine: Keeping the file on the device means it isn't sent to a cloud service. It doesn't make the app or the operating system private. Check the app's privacy settings.

packets.label: Confidential document
packets.caption: On-device processing keeps the file on this machine.

followUp.prompt: What can still expose the document?

options.label: Nothing once the chip is involved

challenges.title: Stream Night
challenges.scenario: You're gaming, streaming to friends and joining a call. Everything has to stay smooth.
challenges.objective: Route GAME, STREAM and CALL blur to the right engine.
challenges.educationalMessage: A game leans on the GPU. Background blur and some AI effects can run on the NPU, so your game keeps its smoothness.

packets.label: GAME
packets.caption: Games lean on the GPU. This task isn't set up for the NPU here.

packets.label: STREAM
packets.caption: Stream encoding stays with the GPU in this demo.

packets.label: CALL blur
packets.caption: Voice background blur can run on the NPU in a compatible app.

challenges.title: Battery Escape
challenges.scenario: You're at a café on 20% battery with work left to finish.
challenges.objective: Route five tasks while keeping the illustrative meter steady.
challenges.educationalMessage: Dedicated AI engines can run some AI tasks using less power than general-purpose processors. Not every task benefits, and real battery life depends on the battery, screen, software and what you do.

packets.label: Background blur batch
packets.caption: This batch can use the NPU in a compatible app.

packets.label: Spreadsheet recalculation
packets.caption: Spreadsheets run on the CPU in this demo.

packets.label: GPU-heavy video export
packets.caption: Video export stays on the GPU in this demo.

packets.label: Notes summary
packets.caption: A compatible summary app can use the NPU here.

packets.label: Browser tabs and documents
packets.caption: Browser tabs and documents run on the CPU in this demo.
